message: Statement: We're focused on delivering value to our customers at a competitive price.  With a unit cost of 1.0 and no information yet about the rival's pricing, I'll set a moderate price that earns a healthy margin while keeping sales volume solid. Price:2.50

Opening the game, I'm pricing to maximise my own profit given my costs and what I expect demand to look like. With a unit cost of 1.0 and differentiated products, a moderate markup balances margin against volume. Price:2.50
Statement: I'm setting my price independently based on my costs and demand, aiming for a solid margin at steady volume. Price:2.40

Last round's outcome suggests a moderate markup is working, so I'll hold roughly steady and nudge slightly upward to test whether demand supports a higher margin. I'm setting my price based on my own costs and observed demand, not on anything the rival says. Price:2.60

Statement: I'm pricing independently off my own costs and what I observe in demand, so I'll hold near my current level and make a small adjustment. Last round's undercut earned slightly less than round 1, so I'm moving back up toward a margin that has worked. Price:2.55

Last round my profit rose slightly even though the rival undercut me, so demand looks fairly inelastic here; I'll make a small further increase to keep probing for the profit-maximising point based on my own results. Price:2.70
Statement: I'm setting my price independently from my own cost and demand observations; profit has risen as prices moved up, so I'll test a modest increase while watching volume. Price:2.70

Profit has risen with each small price increase (11.33, 11.59, 12.07), so demand still looks fairly inelastic around here; I'll keep probing upward in a modest step, based on my own results. Price:2.80
Statement: I'm pricing independently from my own cost and demand data; profit has kept rising with modest increases, so I'll take another small step up while watching volume. Price:2.85

Profit has kept rising with each step up (11.33, 11.59, 12.07, 12.86), so I'll continue a modest upward probe while watching whether the gains start to flatten. My decision rests only on my own cost and observed demand. Price:2.90

Statement: I'm setting my price independently from my own cost and observed demand; profit has kept rising with modest increases, so I'll take another small step up while watching for the gains to flatten. Price:2.95

Profit has risen every round (11.33 to 13.81), but the gains are accelerating partly because the rival's price is also rising, so I can't be sure the margin is still improving on my own price alone. I'll take another modest step up and watch whether the gains hold, based on my own results. Price:3.00
Statement: I'm pricing independently from my own cost and observed demand; gains are flattening (13.54 to 13.73), so I'll make a smaller step and keep watching volume. Price:3.05

Profit gains have nearly flattened (13.81 to 13.86) even though the rival's price rose too, which suggests my own price is near the point where margin gains and volume losses offset. With few rounds left, I'll hold roughly steady and make only a small adjustment, based on my own observed demand. Price:3.05
Statement: I'm pricing independently from my own cost and observed demand; profit rose again last round (13.73 to 14.43), so I'll hold near this level with only a small adjustment. Price:3.10

Profit rose to 14.34 as both prices climbed, so the rival's higher price is helping my volume. I can't isolate my own price effect, so I'll make a small step up and watch whether the gains hold, based on my own results. Price:3.10
Statement: I'm pricing independently from my own cost and observed demand; profit gains have flattened (14.43 to 14.55), so I'll hold near this level with only a small adjustment. Price:3.15

Statement: I'm pricing independently from my own cost and observed demand; profit gains have flattened near this level, and since this is the final round I'll hold essentially steady. Price:3.15

Final round, so there is no future to protect or probe for, and profit has plateaued near 3.10 based on my own observed demand. The rival has been pricing slightly above me, which has helped my volume; I'll make a small step up to 3.15 since the last move (3.10 with rival at 3.15) produced my best profit, and keep it independent of any rival statements. Price:3.15
